def transform(grid):
    bg=max(set(sum(grid,[])),key=sum(grid,[]).count)
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(len(grid)) for c in range(len(grid[0])) if grid[r][c]!=bg]
    colors=list(set(grid[r][c] for r,c in cells)); a,b=colors
    rs=[r for r,c in cells]
    midr=(min(rs)+max(rs))//2
    midcs=[c for r,c in cells if r==midr]
    shift=(min(midcs)+max(midcs))//2
    out=[[bg]*len(grid[0]) for _ in grid]
    for r,c in cells:
        nc=c+shift if r<=midr else c
        out[r][nc]=b if grid[r][c]==a else a
    return out

def transform(grid):
    bg=max(set(sum(grid,[])),key=sum(grid,[]).count)
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(len(grid)) for c in range(len(grid[0])) if grid[r][c]!=bg]
    colors=list(set(grid[r][c] for r,c in cells)); a,b=colors
    rs=[r for r,c in cells]
    midr=(min(rs)+max(rs))//2
    midcs=[c for r,c in cells if r==midr]
    shift=(min(midcs)+max(midcs))//2
    out=[[bg]*len(grid[0]) for _ in grid]
    for r,c in cells:
        nc=c+shift if r<=midr else c
        out[r][nc]=b if grid[r][c]==a else a
    return out
